card.text: A Cepheid in the galaxy NGC 1365, 18 million parsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 27.9 days.

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope found it and timed its pulsation at 27.9 days. Its galaxy's distance, 18.3 million parsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
